_comment: Canonical record of every commission emailed to accounting@colaberry.com.
Serves three purposes: (1) idempotency - preflight.py refuses to send a month
that is already recorded here; (2) regression baseline - every past month must
still compute to these figures when the SMI pipeline is re-run, otherwise the
basis has been restated and needs flagging; (3) tier history, so a tier change
is visible before it silently moves Ali's rate.
ali_comm is the value from the SMI workbook K:N block (authoritative).
ali_emailed is what the outbound email actually said, when it differed.
